## Purpose

Describe the user-visible or architectural change.

## Publication safety

- [ ] New examples and fixtures are demonstrably synthetic.
- [ ] No private upstream file, history, internal endpoint, branding, or production evidence was copied.
- [ ] New dependencies and assets have documented provenance and compatible licenses.
- [ ] Tests and `python scripts/audit_public_tree.py .` pass.
- [ ] External mutations, data egress, or credential handling are explicit and reviewed.
